  RootPackage
  public fun nestedParentSeed(): String
    =
      StringLiteral "parent"
  public fun nestedParentProvider(value: String = <expr>): String
    =
      Var value
  public class NestedParentHost()
    internal fun lambdaA
    internal fun lambdaB
    internal fun anonymousA
    internal fun anonymousB
    internal fun referenceA
    internal fun referenceB
    internal fun localA
    internal fun localB
    internal fun expanded
    internal fun generic
  public class NestedParentConstructor(val callback: () -> String = <expr>)
  public class NestedParentGeneric<T>(seed: T, val callback: () -> T = <expr>)
  public enum NestedParentChoice
    First <ctor>
      callback: () -> String = <expr>
    Second <ctor>
      callback: () -> String = <expr>
